programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Sea Patrol: Pups Save Tilly Turbot; Pups Save an Upset Elephant
programs.desc: The PAW Patrol must rescue Cap'n Turbot and Francois' Grandma Tilly after she rides off on a dolphin; Carlos and Tracker call the PAW Patrol to help solve the mystery of a rumbling sound that is upsetting the jungle elephants.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.desc: Rescuing a dolphin pup; a statue sinks in Adventure Bay; a trip to the water park; Cap'n Turbot's boat runs aground; Wally gets tangled in a fishing net; Walinda is tangled in an anchor chain; deep sea diving; the PAW Patrol cleans up an oil spill.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Search and Rescue: Pups Help the Chickens Cross the Road; Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Lost Ryder
programs.desc: Chickaletta's family is scattered around town, causing traffic jams; the Safety and Rescue Pups have to help the chickens cross the road; Chase leads a mission to rescue a lost Ryder which involves clues, tools and Chewington.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Liberty Makes a New Friend; Pups Save the Pup Pup Boogie Contest
programs.desc: Liberty mistakenly brings a bear into town, thinking it's someone's pet; she must fix her mistake and rescue Chickaletta; Francois' hot-air balloon goes out of control before the Pup Pup Boogie Contest; the Pups, with Liberty, race to the rescue.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Windswept Polar Bear Cub; Pups Save a Drive-In
programs.desc: When a windstorm sends a polar bear cub down to Adventure Bay, it's up to Ryder, Everest, and the pups to bring the baby bear back to its family; the pups must save Mayor Humdinger from a runaway movie projector.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups and Katie Stop the Barking Kitty Crew; Pups Save the Glasses
programs.desc: Mayor Humdinger disrupts Adventure Bay with his barking kitties; Katie and the pups rescue the town; Cap'n Turbot loses his glasses.
